texts.zh:
[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。

这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。
texts.en:
An unprecedented solar flare from [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName] has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.

This aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial body. Our analysis of the star's coronal layer shows that its predicted lifespan has been reduced by over three million years.

texts.zh: 释放出的能量还在该恒星系中引发了一场星尘风暴。目前已经采取紧急应对措施。
texts.en: The resulting discharge of energy has triggered a Stardust Storm in the system. Emergency measures are currently underway.

tooltips.zh: [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]内所有的观测站、研究站以及开采站都被摧毁了。
tooltips.en: Every Observation Post, Research Station and Mining Station in [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName] has been destroyed.
